candidates.name: arbisoft
candidates.description: arbisoft is a design-first solutions partner for digital leaders who value digital sovereignty - the freedom to own, shape, and scale the technology that drives their business. for nearly two decades, we have helped companies in edtech, healthcare, and travel build and scale products trusted by hundreds of millions of people worldwide.we deliver design-led solutions built on open-source foundations, with ai woven into everything we do, from how we work internally to how we deliver faster, smarter outcomes for our partners. with 750+ specialists and one of the industry’s lowest talent turnover rates, we operate as a seamless, trusted extension of our partners’ in-house teams.

candidates.name: contour software
candidates.description: contour software is a wholly owned subsidiary of constellation software inc. (“csi”) (http://www.csisoftware.com/). csi acquires, manages, and builds market-leading vertical market software (“vms”) businesses that develop industry-specific, mission-critical enterprise solutions for both the public and private sectors. before going public in 2006, csi received the prestigious “canada’s 50 best managed companies” award in 2005. headquartered in toronto, canada, and operating with a truly global footprint, csi has 30+ years of experience and a presence in 100+ countries, with 1,000+ offices worldwide. to date, csi has completed 1,400+ acquisitions, supports 125+ verticals, employs 60,000+ people globally, and generates annual revenues exceeding $10b.contour software houses and enables augmented teams across 436 departments (including r&d, finance, it, customer support, professional services, sales & marketing, and g&a) supporting 245 business units within csi. with offices in karachi, lahore, and islamabad, contour employees are key contributors to implementing, supporting, extending, enhancing, and renewing enterprise systems that power thousands of medium and large businesses and public institutions worldwide.learn, grow, and make a difference - software for life!

candidates.name: devsinc
candidates.description: we are a global organization with two state-of-the-art delivery centers in southeast asia and four strategically located offices across three continents. with 15+ years of enablement experience, we’ve delivered 3,000+ successful projects, supported clients in 23+ countries, and proudly serve 236+ active clients. driven by visionary leadership with global experience, devsinc drives agility, innovation, and global it excellence.

candidates.name: netsol technologies inc.
candidates.description: netsol technologies delivers state-of-the-art solutions for the asset finance and leasing industry, serving automotive and equipment oems, auto captives and financial institutions across over 30 countries. since its inception in 1996, netsol has been at the cutting edge of technology, pioneering innovations with its asset finance solutions and today leverages advanced ai and cloud services to meet the complex needs of the global market. renowned for its deep industry expertise, customer-centric approach and commitment to excellence, netsol fosters strong partnerships with its clients, ensuring their success in an ever-evolving landscape. with a rich history of innovation, ethical business practices and a focus on sustainability, netsol is dedicated to empowering businesses worldwide, securing its position as the trusted partner for leading firms around the globe.

candidates.name: edge
candidates.description: at edge, we're dedicated to breaking down barriers in hiring. our global hr platform connects exceptional talent worldwide with employers in north america. join us in redefining the hr ecosystem for a world where opportunities know no borders.by making hiring globally as simple as hiring locally, we provide businesses with access to a wider talent pool and help them accelerate their hiring process.spread across 4 continents, we believe in global mobility and disrupting norms of how people can work together.

candidates.name: podium
candidates.description: a few years back, eric (co-founder and ceo) got a frustrated call from his dad. his dad’s tire shop had plenty of happy customers, but only a handful of angry ones were leaving reviews. so we built a product that made getting more reviews as easy as sending a text.launching in 2014, we set out to solve the same problem for local businesses everywhere, but we realized that messaging with customers wasn’t just the better way to get reviews—it’s the better way to do business. we’ve since built a multi-product platform that’s modernizing the way local business gets done. we are here to provide local businesses with everything they need to win. get more reviews, collect payments, send text marketing campaigns, and centralize your communications—all from one easy-to-use platform.#podium #podiumlove #localbusiness #thefutureislocal

candidates.name: samsara
candidates.description: samsara (nyse: iot) builds with the operators who keep the world moving. working alongside the drivers, mechanics, dispatchers, and crews behind the world's most complex operations, samsara turns what they know into technology that makes their work safer and more efficient.tens of thousands of organizations rely on samsara across transportation, construction, logistics, manufacturing, field services, government, and more. built with operators, for operators.

candidates.name: systems limited
candidates.description: systems limited is a globally recognized it software solution company offering state-of-the-art professional services and bpo offerings in the technology landscape.  up and running since 1977, the company has positioned itself as the top it company in pakistan and provides computing strategies and solutions to government and private organizations. systems limited is a global leader in delivering the finest business applications to a comprehensive list of clients from diverse industries that includes several names from the fortune 500.  with more than four decades of industry expertise as the country’s leading software house, we excel in digital transformation, cloud, digital, and data, and have accomplished over 600 projects in the us, europe, pakistan, middle east, and africa.  our offshore facilities comprise over 8500 customer-focused employees that strive to provide them an outstanding customer experience. what makes systems limited stand out is its ability to assist clients and meet challenges in a diversified fashion across crucial touchpoints. our strength lies in our ability to empathize, strategize and innovate with cutting-edge tech and industry best practices that empower customers to modernize legacy systems and transform into competitive business players.  on a global landscape, systems limited has proven itself as a driving force in leading market segments spanning over multiple regions, and continues to provide solutions & products to a budding list of corporate clients and public sector organizations.  our work philosophy is simple - deliver quality & engineer value by generating flexible software solutions. our ecosystem of connected work verticals helps promote inclusivity and foster the company’s winning culture that fortifies its strength as the #1 it exporter in pakistan.

candidates.name: tkxel
candidates.description: tkxel is an ai-native technology partner helping businesses build intelligent systems for lasting business value.since 2008, we have helped businesses solve complex digital and operational challenges through software engineering, product development, and delivery execution. today, that foundation is strengthened by ai, cloud, data, and cybersecurity expertise, enabling us to build solutions that are scalable, secure, and designed around real business workflows.our work focuses on the technology priorities businesses are navigating now: moving ai from pilots to production, using generative ai and ai agents to improve real workflows, modernizing legacy systems, automating manual processes, and building secure digital products that scale.with 18+ years in business, tkxel brings the experience and execution depth to help businesses move from ambition to real-world execution. we are proud to be recognized by inc. 5000 as one of america’s fastest-growing private companies, named among the 2025 global top 100 inspiring workplaces, and ranked among asia’s top 10 inspiring workplaces.our global footprint includes the united states, portugal, saudi arabia, and pakistan, connecting client strategy with distributed engineering delivery.we help businesses build intelligent systems to lead in the ai era.

candidates.name: verkada
candidates.description: transforming how organizations protect people and places.linkedin about: verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive platform that includes video security, access control, sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.today, more than 30,000 organizations, including 100+ fortune 500 companies, rely on verkada. with over $1b in annualized bookings, a $5.8b valuation, and backing from capitalg, sequoia capital, general catalyst, felicis ventures, and next47, we’re scaling rapidly across the global market.physical ai is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and verkada is at the center of it.from retail stores preventing theft before it happens, to warehouses using ai-powered alerts to improve worker safety, to schools detecting and responding to threats in seconds —not minutes— verkada is redefining what modern physical security can do.more than 2 million devices are now deployed across 170+ countries, and we’re just getting started.
